comments: pour is a non-profit initiative with no paid tiers. The audit engine is open source under MIT (https://github.com/pourdev/pour-engine, npm: pour-engine) and was written from the W3C specifications with no dependencies. Criteria that automation cannot verify are returned as a manual review checklist rather than silently skipped, and findings the engine cannot judge conclusively are reported as incomplete rather than guessed at. A Firefox build is currently in review with AMO and can be added when approved.
features: A free, non-profit accessibility suite for the browser. Runs 72 automated WCAG checks, catalogs all 86 WCAG 2.2 success criteria with plain-language guidance, and sends what automation cannot prove to a manual review lane. Adds 43 vision and sensory simulations. Runs entirely locally: no accounts, no data leaves the device.
title: pour devTools
